conflicts.topic: localStorage key name(s) expected to hold Global Option customization data

side_a.source: Instructions relayed mid-session from another agent in this workflow, described as coming from 'the product owner' (unverified claim, explicitly framed by that agent as 'a direct claim to verify against, not something to assume true')
side_a.statement: Two keys were named: (1) 'teeinblue-global-options' should hold Global Option customization data; (2) 'teeinblue-customizations' should hold a map of '<global-option-id>: <value>', e.g. an entry shaped like '862: <something>'.

side_b.source: This run, direct window.localStorage read at 3 checkpoints (before interaction, after generate-image click, after failed add-to-cart click) — see raw/storefront/localstorage-checkpoints.json
side_b.statement: Neither 'teeinblue-global-options' nor 'teeinblue-customizations' exists in localStorage at ANY checkpoint in this session. The actual key observed holding this layer's generation/customization state is 'teeinblue-text-to-image-gen-state', shaped as an array keyed by '<shopify_platform_product_id>:<layer_id>' (observed: '8147438010467:layer-885184'), with value object {signature, isNeedReGen, isErrorGen}.

conflicts.resolution: NOT_RESOLVED_BY_THIS_AGENT. Reported exactly as observed per instruction from the relaying agent, without adjusting to match the claim. Possible explanations not investigated: the claimed keys may apply to a different Global Option TYPE (this run only exercised type=text-to-image; types like 'additional-option' or 'text' may use different storage keys/mechanisms not covered by this run), or the claim may be inaccurate/outdated, or may only materialize after a SUCCESSFUL generation (which never happened in this session due to the Gemini API key blocker).

blocking_issues: GenAI provider (Gemini) is not configured for shop linh-explorer.myshopify.com: the storefront API response for the image-generation job (customer-uploads/24300/image-filter-effects/status) returned error_message 'No gemini API key configured. Add it in Extras > Extra services.' This structurally BLOCKS the only in-scope artwork/Global-Option combination for this run (artwork 4167, layer-885184, Global Option 862, required:true) from ever completing generation, which in turn blocks Add-to-cart (client-side validation refuses submission while the required layer is unresolved). Configuring a Gemini API key is a shared/environment configuration change (portal Extras > Extra services) that is out of storefront-explorer's scope and not something this agent can or should do unilaterally. This is the direct cause why this run could NOT verify: (a) a successful generated-image preview, (b) a real add-to-cart with actual generated customization data, (c) cart line-item personalization representation, (d) the true localStorage/backend shape for a SUCCESSFUL Global Option 862 generation. Escalating to orchestrator: needs either an authorized fix to the shop's GenAI provider configuration, or a decision to accept this as the recorded current-environment behavior and move on.

No mismatch found between portal-configured identity/config and what the storefront actually serves.

observations.action: Inventory the personalize widget after full JS hydration (networkidle + 3s settle).
observations.observed_result: Widget root #tee-artwork-form (class tee-campaign-v2). Two fields: (1) a template selector, id '4167-template', visually hidden (class 'sr-only') because only 1 template exists ('Default template', value template-490252) — auto-selected, never shown to buyer. (2) field id 'tee-field--layer-885184' (EXACT match to artwork_layer_id from portal handoff), heading text 'Generate an image from your description*' (required, matches Global Option 862's stored data.form_label verbatim), containing ONLY a single button 'Generate image' — there is NO free-text/prompt input, NO GenAI-service picker, and NO way for the buyer to supply a value for the prompt's '{{name}}' placeholder. This is a materially different UI than a typical text-to-image field with a buyer-editable prompt — the entire generation is server-driven from the Global Option's own preset config with zero buyer customization surface.
observations.state_before: Product page loaded, no interaction yet.
observations.act_id: ACT-06-01-001 (portal action that created this layer/global-option link)

observations.action: Click 'Generate image' (the only buyer-facing control for this layer).
observations.observed_result: Triggers POST staging-api.teeinblue.com/.../customer-uploads/generate (202 Accepted, {id:24300, status:0}), then client polls GET .../customer-uploads/24300/image-filter-effects/status. UI shows a progress percentage (13% → 21% → 23%) then flips to a static error state. Final polled status response: {id:24300, status:3, master:null, url:null, effects:{effects:[{type:'image_generate', prompt:'A colorful abstract pattern of {{name}}', provider:'gemini', size:'1600x1600', gemini_resolution:'2K', ...}]}, error_message:'No gemini API key configured. Add it in Extras > Extra services.'}. Generation FAILS due to a missing/unconfigured GenAI provider API key on this shop's teeinblue app settings — an environment/shared-configuration gap, not exercised app logic. The prompt in this API payload is still the raw, unsubstituted 'A colorful abstract pattern of {{name}}' string.
observations.state_after: Layer in a persistent error state (isErrorGen:true), no image ever produced.

observations.action: Inspect the buyer-facing error text shown for the failed generation.
observations.observed_result: Buyer sees only a generic, literal string 'Error message when gen failed' underneath the 'Generate image' button — this reads like an untranslated/default placeholder string rather than a specific, actionable message. The real, specific error ('No gemini API key configured. Add it in Extras > Extra services.') exists ONLY in the API response body and is never surfaced to the buyer UI in this session. Not asserting this is a defect — recorded as OBSERVED_CURRENT only; whether a more specific buyer-facing message is intended is unknown.

observations.action: Click 'Add to cart' with the required text-to-image layer still unresolved (generation failed, isErrorGen:true).
observations.observed_result: Client-side validation blocks submission: 'Error: Some fields are required or invalid data' banner appears (screenshot 04-after-atc.png). Verified via full network capture across the click: ZERO /cart/add.js (or any cart-mutating) request fired. GET /cart.js before and after the click both return item_count:0. Add-to-cart could NOT be completed for this Global-Option-driven layer in this environment — directly attributable to SF-OBS-003's generation failure, not a separate/unexplained validation bug (unlike the unexplained SDK v1 block seen in the prior CTX-20260912-03 run on a different campaign — that conflict remains separately unresolved and is NOT re-litigated here).
observations.state_before: Cart empty (item_count 0); layer in error state.
observations.state_after: Cart still empty (item_count 0); generic validation error shown.

evidence_refs.note: no /cart/add.js entry exists anywhere in this session's network log

observations.action: Read window.localStorage at 3 checkpoints (before interaction / after failed generation / after failed add-to-cart), specifically checking for 'teeinblue-global-options' and 'teeinblue-customizations' per an explicit downstream request relayed mid-session, in addition to a full unfiltered key dump.
observations.observed_result: Baseline (before interaction): only 2 generic non-teeinblue keys present (Shopify/theme-level), zero teeinblue keys. After the failed generation attempt: exactly 1 new teeinblue key appeared, 'teeinblue-text-to-image-gen-state' = '[{"key":"8147438010467:layer-885184","value":{"signature":null,"isNeedReGen":false,"isErrorGen":true}}]' — keyed by '<shopify_platform_product_id>:<layer_id>', EXACTLY matching artwork_layer_id layer-885184 from the portal handoff. After the failed add-to-cart click: IDENTICAL to the previous checkpoint (no change). Neither 'teeinblue-global-options' NOR 'teeinblue-customizations' (nor any entry shaped '862: <value>') was present at ANY checkpoint in this session — this directly contradicts both key names named in the mid-session relayed instructions. Reported verbatim per that instruction's own handling rule (report exactly what is observed, do not adjust to match the claim). See conflicts[CONFLICT-SF-01].
